title: squarespace.get_or_adjust_inventory
description: Input/output contract for the two-operation inventory action on the commerce base URL (https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce). get_inventory = GET /inventory (read). adjust_inventory = POST /inventory/adjustments (write, requires an Idempotency-Key header, reversible by submitting an opposite adjustment). VERIFICATION STATUS: the get_inventory output is fully verified — it mirrors the real 21-record capture in fixtures/inventory.json. The adjust_inventory write path is now CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-16 — a full round trip was run against a real variant: incrementOperations (+1) followed by setFiniteOperations (back to the original quantity), with the actual stock level verified via get_inventory before and after each call (10 → 11 → 10). Both calls returned `{ adjusted: true }` from the connector (whether Squarespace's raw response was a JSON body or a synthesized result from 204 No Content was not itself distinguished by this test), and that result was confirmed to accurately reflect that the write took effect. Negative/zero incrementOperations quantities were separately confirmed live, 2026-08-10, to be rejected (see the `quantity` field note below).

examples.description: Decrementing stock: set an absolute target quantity — there is no negative incrementOperations equivalent.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Cursor pagination envelope. Verified against fixtures/inventory.json.

inventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
inventoryItem.description: All five fields were present on every one of the 21 records in fixtures/inventory.json, so all five are required here.

sku.description: Squarespace-generated SKUs look like SQ1157834, but merchant-set SKUs are free-form, so no pattern is enforced.

descriptor.description: Human-readable label, e.g. "Terra chunk [6]" — product name with the variant attributes in brackets.

limit.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-16 — limit:5 against a 51-item inventory returned the same 51 records as no limit at all: byte-identical response, same records, same cursor, hasNextPage:true both times. Same pattern as list_products' confirmed `limit` behavior — this parameter does not reduce Squarespace's page size below its own ~50 default; a smaller requested value is silently ignored. Now confirmed across two separate endpoints (products and inventory), suggesting this may be general Squarespace API behavior rather than something specific to one endpoint. Don't rely on `limit` to control page size below 50; use cursor-based pagination to page through larger inventories.

cursor.description: With `operation`, cursor must be the only other parameter.

adjustInventoryInput.title: AdjustInventoryInput
adjustInventoryInput.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-16 — a full incrementOperations/setFiniteOperations round trip against a real variant succeeded and was verified to take effect (see this schema's top-level VERIFICATION STATUS). At least one operation array must be non-empty. Squarespace rejects the request without an Idempotency-Key header — CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-17 (400 Bad Request, RFC 7807 problem+json body, "Required header 'Idempotency-Key' is not present."; the omitted-header call had no side effect, verified via get_inventory before/after) — supplied here as `idempotencyKey` — optional on this input: the connector generates a fresh one when omitted, and reuses the caller's when supplied, so a caller can control retries deliberately.

idempotencyKey.description: Sent as the Idempotency-Key request header, not in the body. Optional — the connector generates a fresh UUID when omitted.

incrementOperations.description: Adds stock only — quantity must be >= 1. There is no decrement-via-increment: negative quantities are rejected by Squarespace outright (see the `quantity` field note below). To reduce stock, use setFiniteOperations with an absolute target quantity instead.

quantity.description: CONFIRMED LIVE — negative values disproven, 2026-08-10: Squarespace responds 400 INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR, "quantity must be between 1 and 1000000000, inclusive." for quantity < 1.

adjustInventoryOutput.title: AdjustInventoryOutput
adjustInventoryOutput.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-16 — `{ adjusted: true }` was verified to accurately reflect a real write against a real variant (see this schema's top-level VERIFICATION STATUS). Whether the live endpoint answers with this JSON body or with 204 No Content (in which case the connector synthesises this acknowledgement rather than parsing one) was not itself distinguished by that test — either way, the result is confirmed accurate.
